• The word **"locking"** means the action of fastening or securing something with a lock. (ताला लगाना)

 
 
• **Example:** The security guard was responsible for locking the gates every night.
 
 
 
• **"Offence"** refers to a breach of a law or rule; an illegal act. (अपराध)
 
 
• **Example:** Speeding is a common traffic offence that can result in a fine.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "Take the offence of "locking on"."
